title: Luscious Molten Italian Rice Krispies Tiramisu
description: A creative twist on traditional tiramisu, featuring herbal flavors and a molten center, made with Rice Krispies and ayurvedic tamasic friendly ingredients.
instructions: In a large bowl, brew the espresso and let it cool to room temperature.
In a separate bowl, whip the mascarpone cheese and whipped cream until stiff peaks form.
In another bowl, mix the sugar, vanilla extract, and cocoa powder.
Dip each ladyfinger into the cooled espresso for about 3-5 seconds on each side.
In a large serving dish, create a layer of ladyfingers.
Spread half of the mascarpone mixture over the ladyfingers.
Sprinkle half of the sugar mixture and half of the chopped basil leaves over the mascarpone layer.
Repeat the layers, starting with the ladyfingers, then the mascarpone mixture, the sugar mixture, and finally the remaining basil leaves.
Melt the sugar mixture in a saucepan over low heat, stirring constantly, until it reaches 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and carefully pour the molten sugar mixture over the top layer of the tiramisu.
Refrigerate the tiramisu for at least 3 hours before serving.
